statements.statement: The patient has a history of unspecified atrial fibrillation (I48.91)
The patient reports persistent episodes of palpitations that interfere with daily activities
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The service was for extended ambulatory assessment to characterize arrhythmia burden and correlate symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197
The denial was because required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
